visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a handheld camera view inside a small, brightly lit shop filled with sticker photo booths. The walls are densely covered with colorful photo stickers. A man with shoulder-length dark hair, wearing a vibrant floral and graphic print shirt, is seen talking and gesturing. (2) The scene transitions to the interior of a photo booth area, characterized by a bright pink machine with a glowing screen displaying various photo layouts. A blue curtain hangs on the left. The man in the floral shirt interacts with the screen using his right hand. (3) The two men, one in the floral shirt and another in a black graphic t-shirt, are seen in a brightly lit studio-like corner with a blue backdrop. They are playfully holding a large, white prop cake topped with red strawberries. Their facial expressions are animated and cheerful. (4) The men select from a variety of props, including a black leather studded hat and dark sunglasses. The man in the floral shirt holds a golden toy gun, posing dramatically for the camera. (5) The video then showcases a series of rapid screen captures from the photo booth interface, showing different thematic filters like 'DVD cover' and 'Magazine cover'. The men's faces are integrated into these colorful, retro-style designs. (6) The final phase shows the men back in the shop hallway, holding the newly printed sheets of glossy photo stickers. They are examining the stickers closely, laughing, and eventually sticking one onto a pink surface, with the shop's interior visible in the background.

A male voice speaks with high energy and clarity. (2) A metallic 'whoosh' sound effect punctuates the visual cut as the speakers discuss the photo booth features. (3) The primary male voice laughs loudly, followed by the sound of a plastic prop being moved, creating a mid-frequency rustling noise. (4) As the men pose, multiple 'pop' and 'click' digital UI sound effects are heard, simulating the photo capture process. (5) The BGM continues steadily, maintaining a bright, happy atmosphere while the speakers comment on the humorous photo results with high vocal pitch variability. (6) The track ends with the sound of glossy paper rustling and lighthearted chatter as the men examine their stickers.
